query: SELECT strftime(date_trunc('month', date), '%Y-%m') AS month, count(DISTINCT tx_hash) AS txs FROM (SELECT date, tx_hash FROM transaction_scripts WHERE date in <year window> AND script_hash IN ('46afcc024d90db382187d637b0749f1dab783e9d113ff494637dd2ed', '4a84b71b33b2aedf259e259b4d73526f80f212a50feaa2bbf26b8f58', '54a8ac62c311ea39dfee423fc0a2761279f0ffa10aa596d6577ff548')) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
